mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TB_EMPLOYEE ORDER BY employee_no DESC;
SELECT e.employee_no, e.dept_no, d.dept_name, e.employee_name, e.job_title, e.status FROM TB_EMPLOYEE e JOIN TB_DEPT d ON e.dept_no = d.dept_id ORDER BY employee_no DESC
SELECT * FROM TB_EMPLOYEE e JOIN TB_DEPT d ON e.dept_no = d.dept_id WHERE employee_no = #{param}
